name: International Women's Day
blurb: A day for women's achievement and equality, marked by women in tech communities worldwide with talks, hack days and meetups.

name: International Day of Women and Girls in Science
blurb: A UN day for women and girls in science.

name: International Girls in ICT Day
blurb: An ITU-backed day, on the fourth Thursday of April, that encourages girls into technology careers.

name: International Women in Engineering Day
blurb: Launched by the Women's Engineering Society in 2014 to celebrate women engineers and inspire girls into engineering.

name: Ada Lovelace Day
blurb: An international day celebrating the achievements of women in science, technology, engineering and maths, held on the second Tuesday of October.

name: International Day of the Girl
blurb: A UN day for girls' rights and opportunities, often marked with coding and STEM events.
